chapter.title: Intent, proposal, decision and work
chapter.explanation: Radik turns an owner's informational request into bounded work whose inputs and consumers remain inspectable. A model proposes; it does not supply current authority. The conceptual route is Orchestrator → current evidence, AVF and masks → Root route → BSEP → Architect → native Work and actual input consumption → Critic and result Root. BSEP binds the accepted semantic task; typed Work receives the admitted material. This map explains relationships, not a fabricated single trace across P30 and P31. Their producer, validator and consumer records remain separate. Native child Work is also distinct from a provider subagent. PURE invocations keep candidate_id=None and packet_id=None; an informational source-context carrier is a different object. The profile performs no SAVE or external effect.

chapter.title: P30: one document changed
chapter.explanation: P30 compared fictional services Alder and Birch. Alder's response promise changed from one working day to three working days; Birch's text stayed unchanged. Selective E recomputed the affected branch and kept the other native child out of the queue. Pair1 and Pair2 checked the bounded transition and final Root decision. Native retained-child consumption is one fact; the business parent's consumption of the exact historical extract0 TEXT for Birch is a separate, necessary fact. The new business parent combined that preserved material with the changed Alder branch, then delta Critic and application Root accepted the current-source result. A same-process fresh memory readback followed. This separate owner run used six real role calls and 2599.659387333 seconds (about 43 min 20 s), including E at 2124.583643084 seconds. No E was repeated in P31 or in this documentation passage.

chapter.title: P31: one ordinary working route, three tasks
chapter.explanation: A asked for an explanation of Service Fern: annual-plan eligibility, the holiday exception, response commitment and unknown call cost. Actual O/A/C products supplied the condition and exception claims. The output kept urgent requests separate from all requests: “Unknown call cost: The source does not specify call prices, so neither free calls nor any particular charge can be inferred.” A2 focused exceptions and executed revision_audit1. A3 focused conditions and recorded revision_audit2 SKIPPED_GUARD_FALSE; neither continuation changed the original goal or BSEP. B then verified a supplied Linden statement against three documents. Its answer distinguished opened sealed goods, which the policy excludes, from unspecified return-postage responsibility: “This concerns dispatch, not arrival.” B2 consumed the actual unknown claim with no new role call. After returning to A and cancelling it, C became a new accepted four-document Moss task with B as predecessor and a new goal/criterion. It rejected overbroad dispatch, personalized-goods, postage and pickup assurances. Its actual answer said: “Collection beyond that period requires a written extension; without one, the order is cancelled.” C was held out after general wiring was frozen. The final route contains 20 commands, nine started/closed rounds and nine completed O/A/C rows: three each for A1, B1 and C1. B and C retain their original native conclusion_status=ENTAILMENT_REQUIRES_REVIEW; the finite semantic review does not erase that flag. This is a finite semantic examination of fictional inputs, not universal reasoning certification.

chapter.explanation: A4 is EXHAUSTED with work_task_revision_exhausted, not COMPLETED. A6 marked the task CANCELLED; its later run returned REFUSED at prepare_round_sources before any grant, with no new role/Work and the accepted A5 result preserved. Restart restores task information and historical material, not former Host/Root/E/SAVE authority.

chapter.title: What is established and what remains
chapter.explanation: Stage04 combines accepted P30 selective E, this P31 ordinary actual and earlier applicable source-bound controls. The older P31 SOURCE preparation remains a coverage union: a stopped V03 prefix plus a separate V04 C/restart; current success does not rewrite those receipts. Requested model and effort were gpt-6.1-sol/high; returned telemetry records the same model/effort and service tier default. Ledger served_model and role-observation resolved_model remain UNKNOWN. These are separate identities. Byte and source checks verify provenance and exact quotations; model interpretation is evaluated only against these finite criteria, not external truth. Reference Gates 1–6 and Radik Stages 1–8 are separate numbering systems. Stage05 adds qualified experience, feedback and strategy; Stage06 external DRS with independent owners; Stage07 bounded missing pure capability acquisition; Stage08 the connected minimal stand and applicable U4/effect lifecycle. FullAVF/StrongGT, broader mathematics/federation/authoring, production recovery, self-modification and cognitive-needle extensions retain explicit boundaries. N1-18, N1-19, N4-12 and N4-13 remain approved reference deferments, not implemented features. No complete named-needle catalog is established. Publication is a separate owner/curator decision; this dossier is a prepared draft, not a public release.

chapter.title: Engineering lessons with preserved stops
chapter.explanation: The historical stream stop recorded plan_unexpected_stream_event, but the rejected event subtype/body was not saved. It remains NOT_OBSERVED; 47 later synthetic parser cases are compatibility checks, not replay or proof of the exact historical subtype. Scoped P21 measurements showed repeated baseline validation/formatting costs: the 16-read old series took 18.711785916 s and the new scoped series 2.775007831 s. That benchmark stopped before all refusal cases; it is not a controlled whole-E speed comparison. P29 produced a real v01 native return and 19 v01 report kinds, then required-report wiring incorrectly demanded the v02-only E_V02_FINAL_VALIDATION. Its original STOPPED_NO_RETRY remains. P30's admitted report set and complete consumers supplied the subsequent successful witness. P31's earlier isolated V03 hit its engineering ceiling; the separate remaining branch completed the SOURCE coverage union. Finally, a known exception-cleanup defect remains: a driver/monitor exception may fail to preserve deadline.stop_ns and finally may start a second cleanup, allowing nominal waits up to 40 s instead of the declared 30 s if the first SIGKILL path does not reap. The successful normal exits do not exercise or repair that branch. A later maintenance change needs a focused exception/no-reap test; this passage changes no executable source.
